suppress.notes: Reviewed 2026-11-26 (team to confirm). Jetty 11.0.24 comes in through Javalin 6.5.0. The upstream fix for CVE-2026-2332 (HTTP request smuggling via chunk extensions) is in Jetty 11.0.28, but Maven Central only has Jetty 11 up to 11.0.26 (checked 2026-11-26), so no fixed Jetty 11 exists to upgrade to. The real fix is migrating to Javalin 7 (Jetty 12), tracked as follow-up work. Partial mitigation: in the AWS deployment the app is only reachable through an Application Load Balancer, which parses and re-originates HTTP requests. Re-evaluate on the expiry date.
